invariants.rationale: The method uses tileSet.getProperties() and tileSet.getTile(), so tileSet must not be null.
The atlas is dereferenced and used in multiple places, so it must not be null at this point.
The property 'tilewidth' is set to tilewidth directly before method exit.
Tile arrangement for the main image relies on positive nonzero dimensions; these are required only if a main imageSource is set and nonempty.
The method iterates over tiles as an array, indicating tiles is not null and is an array at this program point.
